name: 3dmodels-vincentteo-com
description: Parametric 3D Model Customizer & Exporter powered by Onshape and Cloudflare Workers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "worker,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev -w packages/backend" "npm run dev -w packages/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/backend && npm run build -w packages/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/frontend && npm run lint -w packages/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/frontend && npm run typecheck -w packages/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/backend && npm run test -w packages/frontend
